name: player_apply_pitch_roll_velocity_impulse_from_direction
description: Player::ApplyPitchRollVelocityImpulseFromDirection transforms a direction by the player's root-node rotation and applies pitch, roll, and local X/Z velocity impulses.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent Player source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x429430 shows the input direction copied to a stack zVec3, transformed through zMath::MatLoadRotationFrom3x3 on playerState->rootNode's Object3D matrix, and applied to vehiclePitchRad, vehicleRollRad, localVel.x, and localVel.z using the two stack scale factors.
The native smoke checks the root-matrix direction transform, verifies the pitch/roll/local-velocity updates, and verifies the zMath current-matrix stack is restored after the helper returns.
